crossings.note: Al Kharid / Lumbridge river boundary, and the only crossing on it. Its two Gate locs are decorative -- opening them does nothing. walkTo across x=3268 is client_rejected from every tile tried until the toll dialog below is completed, at which point the same walk succeeds instantly. Confirmed live 2026-09-08. Three details each cost a session: (1) it is a TOLL costing 10 coins -- a character with an empty purse completes the whole dialog and is still refused, with no message saying why, which reads exactly like a hard block; (2) it works only from z=3227 -- all confirmed crossings depart (3264-3267, 3227) and land (3273, 3227), while z=3228 has none, so being one tile off looks like a wall; (3) the crossing hop is 6-9 tiles, longer than walkTo's ~7-8 cap, because it behaves like a dialog-gated teleport -- send ONE direct walkTo to 'beyond' rather than hopping. Because the boundary is a river, a character on the west bank north of z~3240 cannot reach the eastern corridor (x~3269-3277) by walking east at its own latitude; it is walking into water and reports 'moving but not closing on the target'. Go south to z=3227, cross, then north.

Lumbridge/Varrock. The southern world and the Varrock area are separate regions in this file's own recorded history: everything walked in the north was walked by a character that was already there, so for a long time no route existed between them and route.py correctly reported no_known_route. This is the crossing that links them, found by route.py --explore probing the narrowest unwalked gaps between the two regions. It is a plain walk -- no gate, door, stile or dialog -- which is why nothing in the world announces it and why only exploring found it. Confirmed live 2026-09-09.

confirmed_paths.note: Draynor-area farm back to Lumbridge courtyard. Clean, no obstacles.

open_problems.note: Corrects an earlier, wrong hypothesis logged here that this area had no Gate/Door/Stile/Fence in it at all -- it does; multiple Gates, a Door, and several Stiles were found and successfully crossed heading north from Al Kharid through here on 2026-09-08 (see the obstacle list this entry replaces, in git history). The actual problem: it's a maze of small farm plots, each individually crossable, that don't compose into a route north. Two separate live attempts, one over 30-odd hops and dozens of individual crossings, made real net progress for a while and then landed in a pocket (centered roughly on 3205-3210, 3286-3301) where every crossable loc and every sidestep only led to another already-visited tile inside the same pocket -- confirmed by recipes/travel.py's own progress test (Chebyshev distance to target, checked against the best seen this trip), not just a hunch. Working hypothesis, still unconfirmed: this farm was never meant as a through-route at all, and the real Lumbridge-Varrock road lies further east, outside this area entirely. Try approaching Varrock via the direct road from Lumbridge courtyard (see the lumbridge_courtyard landmark) without detouring through Al Kharid or Draynor first, rather than re-attempting a path through this pocket.
